meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel (Hindi) EP11: at 11 PM Bablu holds a paper bill, the minister's room was free so how does he show it on the bill; Priya adds room 204 is under repair yet still got booked; Kaka at his chai stall says even a room that does not sell counts in the books, write the complimentary room on the bill and block the broken room on the Rizstay room board; Priya shows 204 now shows blocked on the room board so nobody can book it by mistake; Bablu: free room on the bill, 204 blocked on the board

beats.label: BABLU KA HOTEL · EP 11 · FOLLOW KARO
beats.say: Mantri ji ka room free tha... ab bill mein kaise dikhaun?

beats.label: COMMENT ROOM · FREE 5-POINT CHECK
beats.say: Sir, aur 204 abhi repair mein hai, phir bhi book ho gaya!

beats.label: KAKA KI SEEKH
beats.say: Beta, jo kamra bikta nahi, woh bhi hisaab mein aata hai.

beats.label: 1 · FREE ROOM BHI BILL MEIN
beats.say: Beta, Rizstay mein complimentary room bhi bill mein likho,

beats.label: 2 · KHARAB KAMRA BLOCK
beats.headline: Kharab kamra? *Block karo.*
beats.say: aur kharab kamra room board pe block kar do.

beats.label: 2 · LIVE ROOM BOARD
beats.headline: 204: *blocked.*
beats.say: Sir, Rizstay ke room board pe 204 ab blocked dikhta hai...

beats.label: KOI GALTI SE BOOK NAHI
beats.say: koi galti se book nahi kar sakta.

beats.label: EP 12 KAL · FOLLOW KARO
beats.say: Ab free room bhi bill mein, aur 204 board pe blocked! Follow karo!
